title: NOC & Office Manager
description:
**Job Purpose** :The NOC Manager leads, governs, and optimizes our 24/7/365 Global Network Operations Center based out of Pune. This role is responsible for driving operational excellence, maintaining high network availability, meeting strict SLA/KPI metrics, and leading a high-performing team of Shift Leads and L1/L2/L3 engineers. The IT & NOC Manager acts as the single point of accountability for major incident management, operational governance, vendor performance, and continuous process improvement across global and domestic network infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities & Governance:**

**Operational Leadership & Team Management**

 Direct day-to-day operations of a multi-tiered 24/7/365 NOC team (L1, L2, L3 engineers,

and Shift Leads).

 Manage shift rostering, capacity planning, resource allocation, and holiday scheduling to

ensure 100% operational coverage without gap risks.

 Set team targets, drive performance evaluations (KPIs/OKRs), conduct regular 1-on-1s,

and build structured career progression pathways for team members.

 Lead hiring, onboarding, skill-gap assessments, and technical training programs to

continuously upgrade team capabilities.

**Service Level Management & SLA Governance:**

 Own service delivery metrics, including **MTTD** (Mean Time to Detect), **MTTR** (Mean

Time to Restore/Resolve), **First Contact Resolution (FCR), and SLA compliance**

**percentages.**

 Establish, audit, and refine Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), incident runbooks,

escalation matrixes, and shift handover protocols.

 Conduct regular ticket audit reviews to ensure operational quality, proper work notes

logging, and strict adherence to ITIL frameworks.

**Major Incident & Crisis Management:**

* Function as the ultimate operational escalation point for critical (P1/P2) network

outages and severe service degradations.

* Direct Major Incident Response bridges, ensuring coordinated technical response

between internal infrastructure teams, L3 architects, third-party vendors, and executive

leadership.

* Own the Problem Management process: oversee Root Cause Analysis (RCA)

investigations, draft executive Post-Incident Reports (PIR), and track corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) through completion.

**Vendor, Telecom & Executive Stakeholder Alignment**

 Manage performance and SLAs of major Indian and global telecommunications

providers and hardware OEMs.

 Drive quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with key suppliers to ensure circuit availability

and hardware RMA SLA compliance.

 Draft and deliver regular operational dashboards, trend analysis reports, and

performance summaries to executive leadership and global client stakeholders.

**Operational Automation & Process Improvement:**

 Identify opportunities to reduce operational noise through alert optimization,

automated event correlation, and self-healing workflow implementations.

 Partner with Cloud, Security (SOC), and Systems engineering teams to transition new

network technologies, branches, and cloud assets into active NOC monitoring.

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**

 **Education:** B.E. / B.Tech, MCA, or equivalent technical degree.

 **Experience:** 9 to 10 years in IT Infrastructure/Networking, with at least 4 to 6 years in a

formal NOC managerial or leadership role managing 24/7 operations teams.

**Certifications ( Highly Preferred ):**

**ITIL v4 Foundation / Managing Professional**

Technical credentials: **CCNP / CCIE** (Enterprise/Security), or equivalent vendor

certifications (Palo Alto PCNSE, Fortinet NSE 7).

Leadership / Project Management certs are strong advantages.

**Technical & Management Competencies:**

**Technical Depth:** Solid foundational understanding of enterprise networking (BGP, OSPF,

MPLS, SD-WAN, IPsec/SSL VPNs, VLANs, Firewalls) and cloud connectivity (AWS Direct

Connect, Azure ExpressRoute).

**ITSM & Monitoring Ecosystems:** Expertise in deploying and managing enterprise ITSM

platforms (ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, Jira Service Management) and monitoring suites

(SolarWinds, PRTG, Datadog, Splunk, Zabbix).

**Operational Governance:** Strong mastery of ITIL Incident, Problem, Change, and

Capacity Management processes.

**Analytics & Reporting:** Proficiency in data analysis, dashboard creation (Power BI,

Tableau, or ServiceNow Analytics), and trend forecasting.

**Soft Skills & Leadership Qualities:**

**Crisis Leadership:** Proven capability to remain composed, authoritative, and decisive

during complex high-severity incidents.

**Executive Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills

to present technical concepts clearly to non-technical business leaders and enterprise

clients.

**People & Stakeholder Management:** Strong emotional intelligence, conflict resolution

capability, and team-building mindset.

Pay: ₹80,000.00 - ₹85,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Applications Engineer, GTM Systems
description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

**HackerOne Values**

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is **Customer Obsessed** and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We **Default to Disclosure** by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners **Win Together** by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

**Senior Applications Engineer, GTM Systems**
=============================================

**Location: Pune, India**
-------------------------

**WorkMode: In Office (Pune)**  
**Shift: UK Shift**

**Position Summary**
--------------------

As part of HackerOne’s Enterprise Data & AI team, the Senior Applications Engineer, GTM Systems will play a critical role in designing, building, and optimizing the systems that power how our Go-To-Market (GTM) teams operate. You’ll focus on hands-on development and integration across our Salesforce ecosystem and connected applications, enabling data-driven decisions and operational excellence.

In this role, you’ll apply an AI-First mindset to automate workflows, simplify complexity, and scale revenue processes that empower our global Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams. You will collaborate closely with system owners and stakeholders across RevOps, Finance, and Marketing to deliver high-quality, sustainable solutions that make HackerOne’s GTM engine faster, smarter, and more resilient.

As we open our new office in Pune, India, we're excited to welcome team members who value in-person connection, collaboration, and shared purpose. All roles in Pune are hybrid by design; remote options are not available. As a fully integrated part of HackerOne's global team, the Pune office will play a meaningful role in advancing our culture and mission. At HackerOne, we Win Together, and our Pune team will help lead the way by shaping a dynamic, in-person culture rooted in purpose and partnership.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

Success in this role will be achieved by delivering on the responsibilities below, aligned with HackerOne’s Talent Principles — AI-First, Change Agility, Data-Driven Decision Making, and First Principles Problem Solving:

* **Lead the end-to-end design and delivery of scalable, secure, and intelligent enterprise systems** that support HackerOne’s transformation into an AI-first organization.
* **Develop, configure, and maintain Salesforce Sales Cloud, CPQ, CLM, and other Enterprise, GTM, and Security applications** to drive business efficiency and scalability.
* Partner across business and engineering teams to identify high-leverage opportunities for automation, integration, and system modernization.
* **Drive the architecture and execution of platform-level capabilities, leveraging AI and modern tooling** to reduce manual effort, improve decision-making, and increase system resilience.
* **Provide technical leadership to internal engineers and external development partners**, ensuring design quality, operational excellence, and long-term maintainability.
* Shape and contribute to our incident and on-call response strategy, playbooks, and processes, focusing on building systems that fail gracefully and recover quickly.
* **Act as a multiplier to mentor other engineers, advocate for technical excellence**, and promote a culture of innovation, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
* **Champion effective change management and enablement**, ensuring systems are not only launched, but adopted, understood, and evolved.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* **6+ years of experience in an Engineering, Science, Systems, or similar role** w/ proven track record of leading the design, development, and deployment of AI-First Enterprise Systems.
* **Extensive hands-on experience designing, building, configuring, integrating, and maintaining AI-first enterprise systems, including Salesforce, Workday, Slack, Atlassian, Ironclad, Luminance, Box, Monday, Jira and more.**
* **Experience working with SSO protocols (e.g., SAML, OIDC, SCIM),** enterprise identity tools (e.g., Okta), and MDM platforms in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience developing integrations and automations using tools like Workato.
* **Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, CPQ, Stigg, Salesloft, and data enrichment platforms (e.g., Clay, ZoomInfo, etc.).**
* Passion for working backwards from the Customer and empathy for business stakeholders.
* Proven track record of having substantial impact across the company, demonstrating your ability to drive positive change, and achieve significant results.
* Thrive on solving ambiguous problem statements in an early-stage environment.
* Excellent communication skills, and can present data-driven narratives in verbal, presentation, and written formats.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **Salesforce Administrator or Platform Developer certification(s).**
* Experience with AI or workflow automation tools that enhance system efficiency and scalability.
* Familiarity with modern data visualization or analytics tools (e.g., Looker).
* Exposure to integration frameworks, REST APIs, or middleware such as Workato, Fivetran.

**Experience Required:** 6–10 Years  
**CTC Budget:** ₹12–13 LPA  
**Work Location Requirement:** Pune-based candidates only

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Tools Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Splunk AIOps, enterprise observability platforms, OpenTelemetry (OTEL), AWS Cloud, scripting, and Jenkins CI/CD.

The selected candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and optimizing enterprise monitoring and observability solutions. The role involves building telemetry pipelines, automating operational workflows, troubleshooting production issues, and ensuring the reliability and performance of complex cloud-native environments.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise monitoring and observability solutions using Splunk.
* Implement and manage OpenTelemetry instrumentation, collectors, and telemetry pipelines for logs, metrics, and traces.
* Configure and optimize Splunk data ingestion, indexing, dashboards, alerts, and reports.
* Develop automation scripts using Python, Shell, or PowerShell.
* Build, maintain, and optimize Jenkins CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize observability platforms and AWS cloud environments.
* Collaborate with application and infrastructure teams to define monitoring and operational requirements.
* Automate deployments, configuration management, and operational workflows.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA), troubleshoot production incidents, and implement continuous improvements.
* Support production environments to maintain platform reliability, scalability, and performance.

Required Skills and Experience

* 6–10 years of relevant professional experience, with strong hands-on expertise in Splunk AIOps.
* Practical experience with Splunk-based monitoring, alerting, dashboards, data ingestion, and observability.
* Experience with OpenTelemetry instrumentation, collectors, and telemetry pipelines.
* Strong knowledge of AWS Cloud and cloud-native monitoring.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting language: Python, Shell, or PowerShell.
* Experience building and maintaining Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and operational automation skills.
* Experience supporting enterprise or production environments.

Mandatory Eligibility Criteria

* Candidates must currently be based in Pune, Maharashtra.
* Candidates requiring relocation to Pune will not be considered.
* Strong hands-on Splunk AIOps expertise is mandatory.
* Candidates must have 6–10 years of relevant experience.

Compensation

The CTC budget for this opportunity is **₹12–13 LPA**, subject to the employer's evaluation and offer process.

Application Instructions

Interested candidates should share their updated resume along with the following details:

* Total professional experience.
* Relevant hands-on Splunk AIOps experience.
* Current location in Pune.
* Current CTC and expected CTC.
* Notice period.
* Experience with OpenTelemetry, AWS Cloud, scripting, and Jenkins CI/CD.

**Please apply only if you meet the mandatory Splunk AIOps, relevant experience, and Pune location requirements.**

**Client:** Wipro  
**Payroll:** Codersbrain Technologies

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,300,000.00 per year

title: Associate Director - Product Engineering
description:
**Company:**
------------

Marsh

**Description:**
----------------

We are seeking a talented individual to join our IT team at Marsh. This role will be based in Pune. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

  
  

Our scaled Agile Delivery Methodology is transforming our IT teams in cohorts of Pods and Squads. If a Squad is defined as the smallest number of people required to deliver product functionality to market then a Pod is the smallest number of Squads required to deliver a complex product or collection of integrated products to market. Pods exist to create Products and services that deliver on business focused Missions. We in Product Delivery Engineering are on a mission: to transform the way our Mercer business and IT teams work together to unlock the benefits of rapid delivery of quality, secure software to market by empowered teams. We will do this by rolling out our Agile at Scale Delivery model. You will guide one or more Squads and will be responsible for their delivery of working software through production.

  
  

We are looking for a highly motivated, experienced Squad Leader with an enthusiasm for all aspects of product development who knows how to work with a team of highly skilled engineers. Our goal is to create an environment where continuous improvement of the development process is in focus and where everyone's common goal is to deliver outstanding software as fast as possible. You will be a proven expert in using the Agile / Scrum / Lean software development methodologies, a guardian of the delivery team's development processes and driven by delivering value. The Squad Lead will be an excellent communicator and facilitator, and not afraid to raise issues and drive change to remove impediments from the delivery team. You will have some familiarity with leading squads that incorporate AI solutions into their product(s).

  

**We will count on you to:**

  

* Run the software delivery for your Squad ensuring there are smooth and efficient processes for getting software through from requirements to working in production
* Identify and work to eliminate blockers
* Responsible for ensuring your Squad is motivated, collaborative, efficient and empowered
* e2e Delivery of working software for 1 or more products or solutions into production
* You will generally be responsible for 2 squads of between 5-9 people
* You will have an Enterprise mind-set able to foster collaboration, break down silos, identify and work to remove blockers
* You will be a recognized Agile Expert intimately familiar with the processes and practices required for successful and sustainable delivery. Our main delivery methodologies are Scrum and Kanban
* You will be proficient at creating highly performing teams and take a hands on approach where required
* Hands on experience of a range of squad-based roles is an advantage
* Solid understanding of Software Development, Architecture, Test Engineering and Security best practice in an Agile environment
* Pods support the full lifecycle of a product, and we operate on the philosophy that the work comes to the team. You will need to consider tech debt, obsolescence, security and modernization
* Ensure our Agile governance and ceremonies are in place and effective
* Plan product releases
* You will be familiar with acting as Scrum Master for teams developing or receiving AI solutions
* Our standard metrics are visible and actively being used to drive making choices
* Own the Continuous Improvement backlog for your squad. This is the key mechanism by which we deliver improvements for the following; time to market, efficiency and quality
* You will provide coaching and support to your squad ensuring that they operate well as a team and foster o culture of ownership and respect
* You may be asked to be a line manager to 1 or more other squad leads
* In addition to your day to day activities you will be assigned 1 or more workstreams leadership opportunities that will deliver cross-functional benefits to our organisation
  

**What you need to have:**

  

* Bachelors in a technology related discipline, or a combination of work experience, education and training equivalent to a five-year college in a technology related discipline.
* 12+ years of total experience
* Experience and track record of successful delivery in a regulated, complex, multi-product technological landscape. We also have significant security processes and legislative requirements to protect our customers and their data
* You will be expected to have a broad technical understanding to support your Agile credentials from software architecture through test, DevOps practices, security and operational run
* A metrics driven approach to delivery evaluation and drive out systems and processes that help define and report on the metrics we believe to be important
* Excellent stakeholder management skills. As we work to transform the Mercer IT and Business into a truly Agile organisation you will need to influence and coach senior executives, many of whom will be new to Agile
* Ideally familiarity with managing AI model developments into existing and new applications
* Pods and squads are distributed globally and utilise a mix of permanent and partner staff who work largely remotely so experience of working with and motivating distributed teams is vital
* You will be collaborative, Inquisitive and interested in technology and best practices
* Experience of a wide range of Technology roles is desirable, ideally with some form of development engineering background
* Rounded and holistic understanding of Agile Methodologies such as CSP, KMP & ICP-ACC Certifications or their equivalent
  

**What makes you stand out:**

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, comfortable interfacing with business users
* Good troubleshooting and technical skills
* Able to work independently
  

**Why join our team:**

  

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

  
Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

description:

title: Sr./Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer
description:
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Design, develop, integrate, and debug embedded firmware for 32-bit ARM-based microcontrollers, including STM32 and NetX90.
* Develop embedded software using Embedded C/C++, with strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, memory management, and real-time operating systems.
* Develop device drivers and low-level interfaces using I²C, SPI, UART, and other peripheral interfaces.
* Develop and integrate industrial communication protocols including PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen, and IO-Link.
* Develop embedded web pages and user interfaces using JavaScript and HTML, including configuration and diagnostic features.
* Develop, maintain, and validate device configuration and integration files such as GSD/GSDML, EDS, and IODD for PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, and IO-Link devices, supporting PLC configuration and fieldbus integration.
* Perform functional testing of fieldbus nodes using industrial PLCs such as Siemens, Rockwell, and similar platforms.
* Design and integrate REST APIs for device configuration, diagnostics, monitoring, and communication.
* Perform hands-on firmware debugging, optimization, integration, testing, and root-cause analysis.
* Collaborate with hardware and system teams for board bring-up, product integration, and validation.
* Conduct code reviews and contribute to firmware architecture, coding standards, reusable components, and best practices.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to firmware engineers and support resolution of complex technical issues.
* Contribute to project planning, technical estimation, documentation, project metrics, and EIC-Pune initiatives.
* Perform product/system-level testing in the Engineering Laboratory while following applicable safety practices and guidelines.

**Who You Are:**

As a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer, you are a hands-on technical contributor with expertise in ARM/STM32, NetX90, Embedded C/C++, device drivers, and low-level interfaces (I²C, SPI, UART). You have strong knowledge of PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen, and IO-Link, including fieldbus testing with Siemens/Rockwell PLCs. Experience in JavaScript, HTML, REST APIs, data structures, debugging, and firmware architecture, with the ability to provide technical guidance and mentoring. You are experienced in developing scalable, reliable, embedded software, collaborating across hardware and software teams to deliver robust and time-critical motion control solutions.

**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Bachelor of Engineering degree or equivalent in Electronics, Electronics & Telecommunication, or related field.
* 8+ years of hands-on embedded firmware development experience, preferably in industrial automation, motion control, or connected products.
* Strong expertise in 32-bit ARM, STM32, NetX90, Embedded C/C++, data structures, algorithms, and firmware architecture.
* Hands-on experience in device driver development and low-level interfaces such as I²C, SPI, and UART.
* Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols: PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen, and IO-Link, device configuration files like GSD, EDS, IODD etc.
* Experience with fieldbus functional testing using PLCs, such as Siemens and Rockwell.
* Hands-on experience in JavaScript, HTML, embedded web pages, and REST APIs.
* Experience with RTOS/non-RTOS development, debugging, unit/integration testing, and Git-based development.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with experience in board bring-up, hardware-software integration, and product validation.
* Ability to provide technical guidance and mentoring while remaining primarily hands-on as an individual contributor.
* Strong communication, collaboration, documentation, and problem-solving skills; experience working in a global engineering environment preferred.
* Good verbal English communication skills with a neutral accent and a strong commitment to company values, ethics, and continuous learning.
* Respect for company values and ethics, with a strong willingness to learn.

  

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* Familiarity with PLC-based system integration, fieldbus certification/testing, and industrial product development.
* Familiarity with Protocol pre-conformance test environment and process.
Experience in industrial automation, factory automation, motion control, or process control systems.

By joining Emerson, you will be given the opportunity to make a difference through the work you do.

We attract, develop, and retain exceptional people in an inclusive environment, where all **employees can reach their greatest potential** . We are dedicated to the ongoing development of our employees because we know that it is critical to our success as a global company.

Safety is paramount to us, and we are relentless in our pursuit to provide a **Safe Working Environment** across our global network and facilities.

Through our benefits, development opportunities, and an inclusive and safe work environment, we aim to create an organization our people are proud to represent.

We believe a diverse and inclusive work environment contributes to the rich exchange of ideas and diversity of thoughts, that inspires innovation and brings the best solutions to our customers.

* Experience defining governance operating models (data ownership RACI, stewardship councils, policy lifecycle).

**Job Description – Lead Workato Developer (LMS Integration & Automation)**

**Experience:** 6–8 Years

**Role:** Technical Lead – Integration & Automation

**Platform:** Workato

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Lead Workato Developer with 6–8 years of hands-on experience in Workato and enterprise integration development to lead the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of integration workflows for Harbinger's Learning Management System (LMS) platform.

The role requires strong expertise in the Workato platform, including recipe development, API integrations, workflow orchestration, data transformation, error handling, and automation governance. The ideal candidate should combine deep technical expertise with the ability to lead integration initiatives, guide developers, and ensure the reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability of enterprise automation solutions.

The candidate will work closely with architects, business analysts, project managers, backend developers, and other technical stakeholders to translate business and integration requirements into robust automation solutions. They should also be forward-thinking in their approach to AI-assisted development, intelligent automation, and AI orchestration, identifying opportunities to improve delivery efficiency and evolve integration capabilities.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of Workato-based integrations and automation workflows for LMS platforms.
* Design, develop, and optimize complex Workato recipes using triggers, actions, conditional logic, data transformation, and reusable components.
* Build and manage integrations between LMS platforms and enterprise applications, databases, third-party systems, and custom APIs.
* Develop and maintain REST API integrations, webhooks, and event-driven workflows.
* Translate business requirements and technical specifications into scalable, secure, and maintainable integration solutions.
* Lead technical discussions, review solution designs, and establish best practices for Workato development.
* Implement robust error handling, retry mechanisms, logging, monitoring, and exception management to ensure reliable workflow execution.
* Troubleshoot integration failures, perform root cause analysis, and implement permanent corrective actions.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across interconnected systems.
* Guide developers in writing efficient recipes and following coding, documentation, and integration standards.
* Collaborate with backend engineers, architects, DevOps engineers, and QA teams to ensure seamless integration across the platform.
* Manage integration releases, environment configurations, testing, and deployment activities.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, eliminate manual interventions, and improve automation performance.
* Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted development tools and Workato AI capabilities where appropriate to improve productivity and automation outcomes.
* Take ownership of integration architecture, technical quality, and long-term maintainability.

  

**Core Technical Skills**

* Workato Platform Expertise

* 6–8 years of relevant experience, including at least 6 years of hands-on Workato development experience.
* Strong expertise in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining complex Workato recipes.
* Experience with:
* Recipe development, triggers, actions, and conditional logic.
* Recipe functions, callable recipes, and reusable automation components.
* Data mapping, transformation, filtering, and orchestration.
* Error handling, retries, exception management, and operational monitoring.
* Workato connectors, including standard and custom connectors.
* API platforms, webhooks, and event-based integrations.
* Understanding of Workato environments, connection management, deployment practices, and access controls.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex integration issues and optimize recipe performance.

* API & Enterprise Integration

* Strong understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, JSON, and XML.
* Hands-on experience integrating SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, databases, and custom-built systems.
* Knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms, including OAuth 2.0, API keys, and token-based authentication.
* Experience with pagination, rate limits, asynchronous processing, retries, and API error handling.
* Understanding of enterprise integration patterns, system interoperability, and data synchronization.
* Exposure to microservices and event-driven architecture is preferred.

* LMS Integration Expertise

* Experience integrating Learning Management Systems (LMS) with enterprise applications and third-party platforms.
* Understanding of LMS workflows such as:
* User provisioning and learner account synchronization.
* Course and learning content synchronization.
* Enrollment, completion, and progress tracking.
* Learning records and reporting data exchange.
* Integration with HRMS, CRM, identity management, and other enterprise systems.
* Ability to understand LMS data structures and design reliable, automated data exchange workflows.
* Familiarity with standards such as SCORM, xAPI, or LTI is an advantage, depending on the integration requirements.

* Programming & Data Handling

* Strong understanding of data structures, data transformation, and validation.
* Ability to read, understand, and troubleshoot API payloads and integration logic.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases for data validation and troubleshooting.
* Basic scripting knowledge in Python or JavaScript is preferred.
* Familiarity with regular expressions, data mapping, and JSON/XML processing.

title: Intune Administrator / L2 Engineer

**Job Title:** Microsoft Intune Administrator — L2  
**Department:** IT Infrastructure & Endpoint Management  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience Required:** 3–5 Years  
**Location:** Pune, Work from office

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Microsoft Intune Administrator at the L2 level to manage, configure, and support our enterprise endpoint management environment. The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, and the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem, with a strong understanding of device lifecycle management, compliance policies, and security hardening across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android platforms.

Key Responsibilities

**Endpoint Management & Configuration**

* Design, deploy, and manage Microsoft Intune policies including Device Configuration Profiles, Compliance Policies, Application Protection Policies (APP), and Conditional Access integration.
* Manage device enrollment across all platforms — Windows Autopilot, Apple DEP/ADE, Android Enterprise — ensuring zero-touch provisioning for end users.
* Configure and maintain Windows Update for Business (WUfB) rings and Feature Update policies to maintain patch compliance across all managed endpoints.
* Manage co-management scenarios between Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), including workload migration.
* Administer Microsoft Defender for Endpoint integration with Intune for threat and vulnerability management, attack surface reduction rules, and endpoint detection response policies.

**Application Management**

* Package, deploy, and maintain Win32 applications, Microsoft Store apps, LOB apps, and web clips across Intune-managed devices.
* Configure and manage Microsoft 365 Apps deployment via Intune, including Office Customization Tool (OCT) configurations.
* Implement and manage Application Protection Policies (MAM) for BYOD scenarios on iOS and Android.
* Monitor and troubleshoot application deployment failures using Intune logs, Collect Diagnostics, and CMTrace.

**Security & Compliance**

* Implement and enforce device compliance policies aligned with organizational security baselines including CIS Benchmarks and Microsoft Security Baselines.
* Configure Conditional Access policies in Microsoft Entra ID to enforce device compliance as a condition for resource access.
* Manage BitLocker encryption policies, recovery key escrow, and disk encryption compliance reporting.
* Administer Windows Hello for Business, FIDO2, and certificate-based authentication through Intune and Entra ID.
* Configure and manage Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM) to control local admin rights without compromising security.
* Implement Microsoft Purview Information Protection policies through Intune for data classification and DLP enforcement on endpoints.

**Identity & Entra ID Integration**

* Manage Hybrid Azure AD Join and Azure AD Join configurations and troubleshoot device registration issues.
* Administer Entra ID group-based policy targeting including dynamic device groups and assignment filters.
* Configure and troubleshoot Azure AD Connect for hybrid identity synchronization.
* Support Entra ID Conditional Access policy design and review in collaboration with the security team.

**L2 Support & Incident Management**

* Serve as L2 escalation point for endpoint-related incidents escalated from the L1 helpdesk team — covering Intune enrollment failures, policy conflicts, app deployment issues, and compliance remediation.
* Investigate and resolve complex device management issues using Intune diagnostic logs, Event Viewer, Microsoft Graph Explorer, and PowerShell.
* Document resolutions and root cause analysis in the ITSM ticketing system and contribute to the internal knowledge base.
* Participate in on-call rotation and provide support for P1/P2 endpoint incidents affecting business-critical operations.
* Collaborate with the security operations team during endpoint-related security incidents.

**Automation & Reporting**

* Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts for bulk device operations, policy assignments, reporting, and remediation tasks via Intune Remediations (Proactive Remediations).
* Generate and distribute regular compliance and inventory reports using Microsoft Endpoint Analytics, Intune Reporting, and Power BI.
* Build and maintain Microsoft Graph API-based automation for Intune operations.
* Configure and manage Intune Remediations to proactively detect and fix endpoint configuration drift.

**Documentation & Process**

* Maintain up-to-date technical documentation for all Intune configurations, policies, baselines, and operational procedures.
* Contribute to change management processes by authoring change requests and impact assessments for Intune policy changes.
* Support audit and compliance activities by providing Intune reporting evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, or other applicable frameworks.

Required Skills & Qualifications

**Technical Skills**

* Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune in an enterprise environment
* Strong understanding of Windows 10/11 device management, MDM protocol, and OMA-URI configurations
* Experience with Windows Autopilot (self-deploying, user-driven, pre-provisioning modes)
* Proficiency in Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) — Conditional Access, device registration, dynamic groups
* Solid PowerShell scripting skills for endpoint automation and Intune Graph API interaction
* Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and its integration with Intune
* Hands-on experience with macOS, iOS, and Android device management via Intune
* Familiarity with SCCM/MECM co-management and workload migration
* Understanding of PKI, certificate deployment via SCEP/PKCS, and Intune Certificate Connector
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 Apps deployment and Office customization via Intune

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability for complex L2 endpoint issues
* Excellent written and verbal communication for technical documentation and stakeholder updates
* Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple incidents and projects simultaneously
* Collaborative mindset for working with security, networking, and helpdesk teams

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Microsoft Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) in co-management scenarios
* Exposure to Microsoft Endpoint Analytics and Desktop Analytics
* Familiarity with Zero Trust architecture principles and implementation
* Experience with third-party tools like NinjaRMM, ThreatLocker, or similar RMM/EDR platforms
* Knowledge of ITIL framework and experience with ITSM tools

title: Embedded Automation Test Leader
description:

**Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced Embedded Automation Test Leader with strong expertise in Python-based test automation, embedded systems, and motor control validation. This role focuses on designing automated test frameworks, validating motor control firmware, developing Python test tools, and ensuring robust system performance for motor driven products.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1. Test Automation Development (Python)
  
  
Develop and maintain Python-based automated test frameworks for embedded motor control systems.
  
Build automation for:
  
  
Functional, regression, and performance testing
  
Motor parameter validation & characterization
  
Hardware in the loop (HIL) and system in loop (SIL) testing  
  
  
  
Develop custom Python tools for data logging, plotting, signal analysis, and automated reporting.
  
  
2. Embedded System & Motor Control Testing
  
  
Design and execute test strategies for BLDC, PMSM, and ACIM motor control applications.
  
Validate control algorithms such as FOC, sensorless estimation, speed/torque loops, and position control.
  
Test and analyze PWM, ADC sampling, control loops, current feedback, and communication interfaces.
  
Perform real time system testing using oscilloscopes, current sensors, logic analyzers, and motor test benches.
  
  
3. Test Planning & Documentation
  
  
Create detailed test plans, test cases, and verification protocols for embedded firmware features.
  
Develop automated documentation/report generation pipelines using Python.
  
Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, and results.
  
  
4. System Integration & Debugging
  
  
Work closely with firmware, hardware, and motor design teams to reproduce, isolate, and resolve issues.
  
Perform root cause analysis using structured debugging and data-driven approaches.
  
Support board bring up, integration tests, and product validation cycles.
  
  
5. Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
Mentor junior test engineers in automation, embedded testing, and Python development.
  
Drive improvements in test coverage, automation maturity, and continuous integration workflows.
  
Participate in design reviews and provide testability feedback to embedded and hardware teams.
  
  
Preferred Skills
  
  
Experience with:
  
  
HIL systems (dSPACE, NI, Speedgoat, custom rigs)
  
MATLAB/Simulink for validation
  
Robot Framework or Squish
  
Docker/Jenkins/GitHub Actions for automated testing  
  
  
  
Knowledge of RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr).
  
Background in automotive, robotics, industrial automation, or motor driven consumer products.  
  
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
Strong analytical and problem solving abilities.
  
Excellent communication and documentation skills.
  
Ability to collaborate across hardware, firmware, QA, and product teams.
  
Ownership mindset with ability to lead test strategy and automation initiatives.

**Job Requirement**

Embedded testing, Embedded Firmware, Python, Motor control.

**Role Summary**
================

**The L2 Cloud Operations Support Engineer** will provide operational support for Abbott’s Azure and AWS cloud-hosted environment, covering IaaS, cloud-native networking, Kubernetes platforms, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, backup and restoration, and high availability and disaster recovery. The role requires hands-on troubleshooting, automation, disciplined change execution, and effective coordination with Abbott, cloud providers, security teams, and internal CloudOps stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Cloud-hosted IaaS Environment Support**
--------------------------------------------

* Provide L2 operational support for cloud-hosted IaaS environments and resolve incidents, service requests, and technical issues within agreed processes.
* Coordinate with Azure and AWS support teams for cloud service-related issue resolution, escalation management, and service continuity.
* Leverage, maintain, and enhance automation scripts to streamline recurring operational and support activities.
* Provision virtual machines using approved operating system golden images through Terraform and Ansible.
* Identify unused or idle virtual machines and coordinate their power-down to optimise cloud consumption and cost.
* Decommission cloud resources in accordance with Abbott’s approved cloud decommissioning process.
* Provide technical coordination for mutually agreed maintenance activities between Abbott and the CloudOps team.

**2. Cloud-native Networking Services**
---------------------------------------

* Provision and update VPCs, VNETs, subnets, route configurations, and associated cloud networking components based on approved designs and change requests.
* Provision cloud infrastructure resources using Terraform for third-party firewall platforms, including Zscaler and Alkira, in accordance with designs and requirements provided by Abbott’s Security Team.
* Troubleshoot L2 connectivity and configuration issues and coordinate with network, security, application, and cloud provider teams for resolution.

**3. Kubernetes Platform Operations**
-------------------------------------

* Provide operational support for cloud-native Kubernetes platforms, including container provisioning, application deployment support, and container lifecycle management.
* Monitor Kubernetes cluster health, capacity, availability, and operational events across all in-scope clusters.
* Capture and report agreed Kubernetes metrics and KPIs and escalate recurring, critical, or capacity-related issues to the appropriate support teams.
* Perform approved standard operational changes and troubleshooting using documented procedures and runbooks.

**4. Infrastructure Orchestration, Automation and CI/CD**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Leverage and enhance Abbott’s existing orchestration, automation, and CI/CD processes for cloud infrastructure management.
* Execute cloud infrastructure pipeline deployments and configuration activities using Terraform and Ansible for in-scope IaaS, CaaS, and PaaS services.
* Orchestrate cloud infrastructure services and resource provisioning within Abbott’s existing cloud Landing Zones.
* Monitor infrastructure pipelines during deployment, analyse failures, perform initial troubleshooting, and coordinate resolution or escalation.
* Maintain reusable Infrastructure as Code modules, scripts, configuration artefacts, and operational documentation under approved version-control and change-management practices.

-----------------------------

* Coordinate backup and restoration activities for Storage Accounts and virtual machines using approved cloud-native backup solutions.
* Perform backup administration, job monitoring, failure handling, restoration support, and backup reporting for in-scope services.
* Validate backup status and restoration outcomes, document evidence, and escalate exceptions or repeated failures through the agreed support process.

------------------------------------------------------

* Coordinate and execute periodic disaster recovery infrastructure failover and failback tests using the existing approved DR test plan.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**

**Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**

*Platform architecture and evolution*

**Function -** Infrastructure & Operations

**Coverage -** Across all clients

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer is the senior technical owner of Merkle Denmark’s cloud platform architecture. The role focuses on designing, building, and evolving the cloud foundations, guardrails, and platform capabilities that underpin client operations — ensuring environments are reliable, secure, and well-governed.

The role is a hands-on specialist position. It sets the direction for how cloud infrastructure is designed, built, and hardened across client accounts, and provides deep technical input on complex incidents, major changes, and architecture-impacting decisions. People leadership, resource allocation, and day-to-day team direction sit with the Engineering Director.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Cloud Infrastructure Engineering**

* Architect and build cloud foundations and platform capabilities across client environments.
* Define secure-by-design patterns, guardrails, and platform standards for Cloud Operations to operate within.
* Design resilience and continuity architecture, including backup/restore strategy and disaster recovery.
* Own and evolve infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices and tooling standards.
* Drive continuous improvement of the platform approach, ensuring it evolves with client needs and industry practice.
* Provide specialist guidance to Cloud Operations Engineers during complex incident investigations, major changes, and architecture-impacting decisions.
* Assess and respond to critical CVEs and security advisory items, coordinating with dentsu EMEA security where required.

**Operational Governance**

* Define platform-level patterns that support incident management, change management, SLA governance, and on-call practice.
* Provide senior technical input on P1/critical incidents and client-impacting situations where infrastructure or platform expertise is needed.
* Ensure platform ownership responsibilities are clearly defined and applied — Cloud Ops owns production stability; Cloud Infrastructure owns design and evolution.
* Maintain platform design standards that support audit-readiness, NIS2, and client contractual obligations.
* Contribute to operational reporting quality, including platform health signals and SLA-relevant metrics.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as senior technical point of contact for client escalations requiring infrastructure or platform expertise.
* Collaborate with Project Managers and delivery teams on change planning, release readiness, and deployment governance.
* Contribute to account-level technical conversations, including architecture reviews and SLA design.
* Support pre-sales and proposal work where infrastructure architecture or managed operations expertise is required.

**Must-Have Skillset –**
------------------------

  

**Cloud Infrastructure Engineer -Over 8+ years of exp**
-------------------------------------------------------

  

* **Cloud Architecture Expertise** (Azure, AWS, or GCP)Design scalable, secure, and resilient cloud platforms Define platform guardrails and architecture standards
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**Strong hands-on experience with **Terraform, Bicep, ARM, or equivalent** Building and maintaining automated infrastructure deployments
* **Cloud Security & Compliance** Secure-by-design architecture principles Platform-level security controls, vulnerability/CVE management Understanding of compliance frameworks, governance, and audit requirements
* **Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity** Design and implementation of DR, backup, restore, and resilience strategiesHigh availability and fault-tolerant architecture design
* **ITIL / ITSM Knowledge** Strong understanding of: Incident Management hange Management Problem Management SLA Governance
* **Critical Incident & Escalation Management** Experience providing technical leadership during P1/P0 incidents Root cause analysis and architecture-level problem resolution
* **Operational Governance** Define platform standards, operational patterns, and best practices Support incident, change, and service management frameworks
* **Client & Stakeholder Management** Act as senior technical advisor during architecture reviews Experience working directly with enterprise clients and stakeholders
* **Multi-Cloud & Managed Services Experience** Experience in professional services, managed operations, or multi-client environments Understanding of contractual obligations, SLAs, and service delivery models
* **Technical Skills** Networking (VNet/VPC, VPN, Load Balancers, DNS, Firewalls)Windows/Linux Server Administration Containers & Kubernetes Monitoring & Observability tools Automation and Scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python)
* Experience with NIS2, GDPR, and data processing regulations
* Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or CI/CD expertise
* Excellent written and verbal English communication Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders

**Nice-to-Have**
----------------

* Danish language proficiency
* Public sector or enterprise platform experience

**Working Context**
-------------------

The role sits within the Merkle Denmark engineering organisation, reporting to the CTO and working closely with the Engineering Director, Infrastructure & Operations. The Infrastructure & Operations function is distributed across Denmark, Bulgaria, India, and the Philippines, and operates across multiple client accounts including public sector and enterprise digital platforms.

The function works within a ticket-first, evidence-driven operational model. Production is owned by Cloud Operations; platform architecture and guardrails are owned by Cloud Infrastructure Engineering. This separation of duties supports governance, auditability, and clear accountability.

Merkle

Full time

Permanent

Our client is a is a location data and technology platform company that empower customers to achieve better outcomes – from helping a city manage its infrastructure or a business optimize its assets to guiding drivers to their destination safely. They create solutions that fuel innovation, provide opportunity and foster inclusion to improve people’s lives. If you are inspired by an open world and driven to create positive change, join us!

As a Senior Backened Engineer in the Map Data Processing group you will develop smart Map Data processing tools for the state-of-the-art Mapping Technologies. You will work self-sustained in an agile team. Your responsibility will cover developing, extending and maintaining tool and services that processes map data for global navigational database. For that you will be translating product strategies into technology strategies, leading the long-term architectural direction and helping design and build industry-grade customer-facing geo-data-intensive products. You will work closely with other engineering & operations teams, internal users of tool chains your team develops and partner with product managers and the larger map operations business units.

### **What project we have for you**

Join our engineering organization to build the next generation of automated map data processing for a global provider of location and mapping solutions used in automotive and mobility.

You will work on the **platform** — a system that takes road data from multiple sources (GPS traces, traffic signs, open map data), detects errors in the map, and either auto-corrects them or flags them for human review. The platform produces quality signals and road attribute corrections that feed directly into navigation and autonomous driving products.

Working as part of an agile, cross-functional team on Rakhee’s team, you will build and maintain backend services and distributed data pipelines that keep this platform accurate, reliable, and ready for production load. The primary language on this team is **Scala** — strong engineers in either language are welcome.

*What you’ll work on:*

* Distributed batch pipelines for large-scale road dataset processing (Spark on EMR)
* Error detection, confidence-based auto-fix logic, and manual review workflows for map attributes
* Data validation, quality gates, and traceability across the pipeline
* Cloud-native execution environments (infrastructure automation, CI/CD, operational readiness)

*Technologies:*

* Scala
* Python( Good to have)
* Apache Spark
* Kafka
* SQL / PostgreSQL
* AWS (Step Functions, ECS, Lambda, EMR)
* Apache Airflow

* Implement and maintain testing practices (Unit, Integration, E2E) for owned components
* Contribute to monitoring, alerting, and observability of production systems
* Improve code quality via reviews, automated testing, and engineering best practices
* Contribute to estimations, planning, and iterative delivery in an Agile/Scrum process
* Share knowledge and support junior team members’ growth

### **What you need for this**

**Required Skills**
-------------------

* **5+ years** building backend systems with **Scala** as your primary language (strong core competency in one — not a shallow familiarity in both)
* Distributed data processing — **Apache Spark** or equivalent (production usage required, regardless of whether your primary language is Scala or Python)
* **Kafka** — event-driven architecture, producers/consumers, production usage
* **AWS** — practical experience with EMR, Step Functions, ECS, or Lambda
* Strong SQL and data modeling — ideally PostgreSQL (schema design, query optimization, indexes)
* Solid knowledge of data structures, OOP, and design patterns
* Good understanding of concurrency and multithreading concepts
* LLD: modular architecture, clean abstractions, component design

-------------

Atlas Copco is on a continuous journey to strengthen data‑driven, standardised, and digitally enabled sourcing processes across its global operations.

As Data Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, optimising, and digitally enabling end‑to‑end sourcing processes, acting as a bridge between Sourcing, Global IT, and Data & Analytics teams.

Your focus will be on SAP‑centric sourcing processes, supported by GEMS, ACDC, robust master data governance, and advanced digital capabilities such as Power BI, Databricks, and Artificial Intelligence, enabling better decisions, transparency, and scalable sourcing operations.

You will work in a cross‑functional, international environment, supporting sourcing teams with robust systems, high‑quality data, and actionable insights.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Sourcing Process & Systems Engineering**

* Analyse, document, and improve end-to-end sourcing and procurement processes, including supplier onboarding, RFQ/RFP, pricing, contracts, source lists, and PO lifecycle.
* Develop and maintain As-Is/To-Be process models, system flows, and data dependencies.
* Act as a process subject matter expert for sourcing-related systems and digital initiatives.

**SAP, GEMS and ACDC Platforms**

* Act as functional SME for SAP MM / SAP S/4HANA sourcing and procurement processes.
* Support and optimise sourcing workflows in GEMS and ACDC, ensuring alignment with SAP and business processes.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications for Global IT and solution partners.
* Support UAT, deployments, rollouts, and hypercare for sourcing system enhancements.

* Support governance of sourcing master data, including supplier master, purchasing info records, pricing, and source lists.
* Work with SAP MDG to ensure data quality, consistency, ownership, and approval workflows.
* Define and monitor data quality rules for sourcing master and transactional data.
* Support root cause analysis and remediation of data quality issues.

**Data, Analytics and Reporting**

* Define and govern sourcing KPIs related to cost savings, supplier performance and risk, spend compliance, lead time, MOQ, and sourcing efficiency.
* Enable data flows from SAP, GEMS, and ACDC into Databricks / Azure Data Lake in collaboration with Data Engineering teams.
* Design and maintain Power BI dashboards for sourcing and management reporting.
* Ensure consistent definitions, transparency, and traceability of sourcing data.

**Artificial Intelligence and Digital Enablement**

* Identify and support AI-driven sourcing use cases such as supplier risk prediction, price trend analysis, and spend classification.
* Collaborate with Data Science and Analytics teams to operationalise AI solutions.
* Drive automation and advanced analytics initiatives supporting sourcing excellence.

**Stakeholder and Change Management**

* Act as a key interface between Sourcing, Global IT, Analytics, and external partners.
* Support user adoption of sourcing systems, reports, and dashboards.
* Develop user documentation, training materials, and support change management for sustainable adoption.

**Your skills and experience**
------------------------------

**Experience & knowledge**

* Solid experience in sourcing or procurement processes within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Strong hands‑on knowledge of SAP MM / SAP S/4HANA Procurement.
* Experience working with business systems, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives.
* Good understanding of data concepts, analytics, and reporting.

**Digital & technical skills**

* Power BI (data modelling, dashboard development).
* Exposure to Databricks or modern data platforms.
* data integration concepts, Basic understanding of SQL

**Ways of working**

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
* Experience translating business needs into system and data requirements.
* Comfortable working in cross‑functional and multicultural environments.
* Structured, fact‑based, and quality‑oriented working style.
* Familiar with Agile or project‑based ways of working.

**Education**

* University degree in Engineering ( Information Technology, or equivalent experience )
* 3 + years of experience

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role.

We offer compensation that reflects the skills, experience, and responsibilities of the role. Pay also depends on the country where the job role is based, as compensation practices vary across our markets. During the recruitment process, we share clear information about the pay and benefits for your location, so you know what to expect before moving forward.

Indian Service Center, Chakan DC - Pune, India

Your career grows through your skills, your curiosity, and the people you work with. You join a global network where we learn from each other and share knowledge openly. We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Azure Data Engineer with strong expertise in Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL Database, and Azure Functions to design, develop, and support enterprise-scale data integration and cloud-native solutions. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building scalable ETL/ELT frameworks, developing robust data pipelines, implementing cloud integration patterns, and ensuring high-performance, secure, and reliable data platforms on Microsoft Azure. * Develop data validation, reconciliation, and quality control mechanisms for enterprise data platforms.
* Build and maintain Azure Functions for serverless integrations, event-driven processing, and automation use cases.
* Integrate Azure Functions with Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, REST APIs, and other Azure services.
* Develop and consume REST APIs for system integration and enterprise data exchange.
* Support deployment automation, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and operational readiness initiatives.
* Participate in architecture reviews, technical governance, and cloud modernization programs.
* Mentor junior engineers and drive engineering best practices across delivery teams.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8?12 years of experience in Data Engineering, Azure Integration Development, and Enterprise Data Platforms.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Azure Data Factory and large-scale data integration frameworks.
* Extensive experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise ETL/ELT solutions.
* Deep knowledge of ADF architecture, orchestration patterns, datasets, linked services, triggers, parameterization, and integration runtimes.
* Experience implementing CDC frameworks, incremental loading strategies, and high-volume data processing solutions.
* Strong expertise in Azure SQL Database development, optimization, and administration.
* Advanced SQL skills including stored procedures, functions, views, indexing strategies, query tuning, and execution plan analysis.
* Experience handling large-scale enterprise data platforms and high-performance data processing workloads.
* Strong understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and enterprise data architecture principles.
* Good hands-on experience developing Azure Functions using C#, .NET, Python, or related technologies.
* Experience implementing event-driven and serverless integration architectures.
* Expertise integrating Azure Functions with Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, and other Azure platform services.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication mechanisms, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience implementing monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and operational support frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Blob Storage and Azure Data Lake Storage.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.
* Knowledge of Azure security concepts including Managed Identity, RBAC, Key Vault, and secure cloud architecture.
* Experience with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and cloud observability solutions.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor engineering teams.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Modeler with expertise in Databricks Lakehouse architecture, cloud data platforms, and Oracle workload migrations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing scalable, governed, and business-aligned data models that support enterprise analytics, AI/ML initiatives, and cloud modernization programs. You will work closely with Data Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, Governance, and Business teams to build modern data platforms that enable trusted, high-quality, and AI-ready data assets.

* Design and develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models for enterprise-scale data platforms.

* Design scalable data architectures that support analytics, reporting, operational, and AI/ML workloads.
* Define and maintain metadata standards, data lineage, data dictionaries, and governance frameworks.
* Support migration of databases, applications, and analytical workloads from Oracle environments to cloud-native data platforms.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to design efficient ETL/ELT pipelines and modern data integration solutions.
* Ensure data quality, consistency, security, compliance, and governance across enterprise data assets.
* Partner with analytics and AI/ML teams to build data models that support advanced analytics, feature engineering, and machine learning initiatives.
* Develop strategies for master data management, metadata management, and enterprise data governance.
* Create and maintain enterprise data standards, modeling guidelines, and best practices.
* Participate in architecture reviews and recommend improvements for scalability, performance, and maintainability.
* Support regulatory and compliance requirements for highly governed industries.
* Work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable data solutions.
* Contribute to cloud modernization and digital transformation initiatives across the organization.

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 7-10 years of experience in Data Modeling, Data Architecture, Data Warehousing, or Enterprise Data Management.
* Strong expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling techniques.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Lakehouse architecture.
* Proven experience designing enterprise-scale data models for analytics and reporting platforms.
* Strong knowledge of metadata management, data lineage, data governance, and data stewardship practices.
* Experience supporting Oracle-to-Cloud migration programs and modern data platform transformations.
* Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, star schemas, and snowflake schemas.
* Experience working with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform environments.
* Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT tools such as Azure Data Factory, dbt, Informatica, Fivetran, or similar technologies.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale structured and semi-structured datasets.
* Understanding of data quality, security, regulatory compliance, and governance frameworks.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Data Engineers, Architects, Data Scientists, and Business Stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

Staff Engineer – AI in Embedded Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Location: Pune, India

  
  

**About GF**
------------

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power-efficient and high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted technology partner for customers around the world. GF's talented global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com.

  

**Introduction**
----------------

GlobalFoundries is seeking a highly motivated Staff Engineer to lead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the embedded software development lifecycle. This role combines deep expertise in embedded systems with practical experience applying Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-powered automation to accelerate software development, validation, and product delivery.

The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader driving the integration of AI-enabled workflows across platform software, firmware, test, and validation teams. This position requires strong hands-on experience in embedded software development, AI/ML technologies, and engineering productivity tooling, enabling the transformation of how software is designed, implemented, tested, documented, and maintained.

  
  

**Your Job**
------------

* Define and drive the technical strategy for AI adoption across the embedded software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, coding, testing, validation, documentation, and release activities.
* Develop AI-powered solutions that generate embedded software components such as low-level drivers, hardware abstraction layers (HALs), BSP integrations, register-access layers, and validation utilities from specifications and hardware documentation.
* Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems utilizing source code, technical documentation, silicon specifications, issue-tracking systems, and historical validation data.
* Build and fine-tune Small Language Models (SLMs) and LLM-based solutions for embedded software generation, test automation, defect triage, and engineering productivity enhancement.
* Develop automated pipelines that convert requirements and design specifications into executable embedded test cases, validation frameworks, and simulation scripts.
* Create AI-based solutions for post-silicon validation, including log analysis, anomaly detection, failure clustering, regression triage, and root-cause assistance.
* Integrate AI-enabled tooling into engineering workflows, source control systems, code review processes, IDEs, CI/CD environments, and validation frameworks.
* Establish model evaluation methodologies and quality metrics focused on correctness, code quality, coverage improvements, build success rates, productivity gains, and developer adoption.
* Define governance, traceability, security, IP protection, and compliance controls for AI-generated software artifacts in safety-critical development environments.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and AI enablement across software, architecture, validation, and platform engineering teams.
  

  

**Other Responsibilities**
--------------------------

* Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.
* Support engineering excellence through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous process improvements.
* Maintain compliance with company quality standards, development processes, and product security requirements.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum **4 to** **8 years** of industry experience in embedded software development, firmware engineering, platform software, or related fields.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
* Hands-on experience developing embedded software for microcontrollers, microprocessors, automotive systems, or embedded Linux platforms.
* Strong understanding of RTOS concepts including scheduling, interrupts, synchronization mechanisms, memory management, and low-level driver development.
* Experience with protocols and interfaces such as CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, or related embedded communication technologies.
* Practical experience with AI/ML frameworks including PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience developing and deploying RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval systems.
* Proven expertise in model fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA.
* Experience integrating AI solutions into software engineering workflows, developer tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated validation environments.
* Knowledge of model serving, optimization, quantization, and deployment in on-premises environments.
* Experience with embedded testing, silicon bring-up, HIL validation, system debugging, and hardware/software integration.
* Ability to work effectively across distributed global engineering teams.
* Ability to travel up to 10% as required.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
* Experience with RISC-V processor architectures, toolchains, and ecosystem development.
* Knowledge of AUTOSAR, safety-critical systems, and functional safety standards including ISO 26262.
* Experience developing IDE plugins, engineering productivity tools, or software developer platforms.
* Experience with MLOps infrastructure, GPU-based training and inference environments, and enterprise AI deployments.
* Exposure to static code analysis, compiler technologies, program analysis, or code intelligence platforms.
* Expertise in AI governance, security, model evaluation, traceability, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience publishing research, contributing to open-source projects, or providing technical thought leadership in AI-assisted engineering.
* Experience working with semiconductor product development, post-silicon validation, or firmware platform teams.
